column8: The angles of a triangle are in the ratio 2:3:4. What is the size of the largest angle?
column14: The ratio has 2 + 3 + 4 = 9 parts. Each part is 180° ÷ 9 = 20°, so the largest angle is 4 × 20° = 80°.
